title: Toward a Rational Extended Thermodynamics of dispersive elastic media
summary: We develop a one-dimensional theory of dispersive elasticity within Rational Extended Thermodynamics, taking local first-order balance laws rather than higher spatial gradients as the fundamental description. A supplementary mechanical-energy law and the Ruggeri--Strumia main-field principle determine the admissible stress, internal fluxes and production. A canonical two-field hierarchy is symmetric hyperbolic under explicit convexity conditions and contains nonlinear elasticity and a generalized-stress theory as principal subsystems.
